name: think-like-an-architect
description: Six guided decision-making tools from Think like an Architect by Carl Vescovi — the 5-Step Decision Method, Decision Logs, weighted Pros and Cons Grids, the Impact vs Effort Matrix, RACI Matrices, and a setup skill to save any of them to a local file, Confluence, Jira, or Google Docs. Built for Salesforce Admins making architect-level decisions without architect training.
